Both are weakest in the middle; LV's middle hole is larger on a 10-attempt sample.

Cousins is the QB the blitz hurts (EPA -0.15 vs blitz, n=19, vs +0.20 clean), which should cut LV deep yards and lift RB/TE checkdowns. Shough stays non-negative vs blitz (EPA +0.04, n=37, vs +0.12 clean), and LV only blitzes 21%, so NO's pass game is not blitz-faded.
matchup.bleeds: NO run defense bleeds: 4.96 YPC allowed and 9 runs of 10+ in two games, but only 4 passes of 20+ on 73 attempts, with the right side the stingiest (5.3 YPA). LV run defense is tighter at 4.02 YPC and 5 runs of 10+. LV pass defense bleeds explosives and the middle: 6 passes of 20+ on 62 attempts and 10.7 YPA on 10 middle attempts.
matchup.overlap: Olave is the primary-target overlap: 23 targets, 338 air yards and 268 rec yards into the defense that has allowed the most 20+ passes in this pack (6/62) and a 10.7 middle YPA. Jeanty's 44 carries meet NO's 4.96 YPC, but his own 3.41 YPC has not matched that environment yet. Kamara (9/15, 1.67 YPC) is not attacking a weak spot; he is not getting the ball.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Olave has 268 receiving yards on 23 targets in two games, and LV has allowed 6 passes of 20+ plus 10.7 YPA in the middle, so 76.5 sits well below both his target share and the spot this defense bleeds.
edge_players.must_be_true: Shough plays, Olave keeps the primary share (338 air yards vs Vele 132 and Johnson 88), and the two-game rate is not one unrepeatable bomb.
edge_players.kills_it: The 268 is one boom game that cannot be split out, LV brackets the top and the explosives don't show up, or he falls to about 6.5 yards per target on a quieter target count and finishes under 76.5.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Kamara has 9 carries for 15 yards (1.67 YPC) while Etienne has already taken the rushing lead at 18/71, so 24.5 rush yards is a name line, not his current role.
edge_players.must_be_true: The committee holds, Etienne is active and keeps early-down carries, and Kamara does not rip a 15-yard run against a LV run defense that has allowed 5 runs of 10+ at 4.02 YPC.
edge_players.kills_it: An Etienne inactive or snap limit that is not in this pack hands Kamara the job, or a goal-line/clock package gives him 10+ carries at even average efficiency and he clears 24.5.

data_check.notes: No projection, sim median, or Pinnacle no-vig is in the pack, so step 8 cannot price the edge and nothing here is a confirmed number. Form agrees: Olave 134 yards/game vs a 76.5 line (-115); Kamara 7.5 rush yards/game vs 24.5 (-114.5), with carry share 9 vs Etienne 18. The disagreement with the strong Olave read is data quality, not a contrary stat: the 268 yards and 338 air yards cannot be split by game, LV's 6 explosives came on only 62 attempts, and a 70%+ style read has been miscalibrated before. Flag Olave for the human; do not cut it. Kamara under is a lean the carry numbers support, with no contradicting figure in the pack. Jeanty 75 rush yards/game vs 69.5 was considered and left off because it is script-dependent and a tighter gap than these two.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because LV sat extra help in the middle, the 10.7 YPA was 10 attempts of noise, and Olave's 268 was a week-1 bomb plus a quiet week 2, so 76.5 was the market already fading the air yards. Kamara got a second-half carry bump and one 12-yard run — Etienne rested or was limited on an inactive list this pack never had — and finished at 28 to beat 24.5, meaning the under was just fading a name the book had already moved off starter usage but not off goal-line work. That counter is real on Kamara and is why he stays a lean, not a strong; it is not stronger than 9 carries for 15 yards versus Etienne's 18/71 on the evidence we actually have, so the leg stays and the human owns the inactive risk.
slip_story: One story: NO's offense runs through Olave, not Kamara. A pass-lean or NO-trailing script cashes Olave recyds over 76.5 and Kamara rushyds under 24.5 together. Do not add Etienne rush over 39.5 or a NO total under, and do not add Jeanty rush over 69.5, which needs LV to stay on the ground and can cut the NO pass volume this stack needs. Two legs, one market per player, no TDs.
